name: lotr
summary: LOTR, one gateway to rule them all: a fixed four-tool MCP surface in front of any number of downstream connections, with a registry of who talks to whom, as whom, from which machine

settings.summary: LOTR agents: separate reader and writer agents (split), or one read/write agent per task (combined).
settings.detail:
split     readers (jira, m365, github, runner) hold find + call_read only; writers hold
          find + call_write (+ call_consent); a change is composed from your words alone  (default)
combined  one agent, gt-lotr:gateway, holds all four gateway tools: fewer hops, cheaper

The split is what stops text inside a read result (an issue body, an email) from steering a
write, an injection. combined removes that protection, so it only takes effect while the
lockdown level is insecure; at any other level it is ignored, the effective mode stays split,
and the reason is stated. Irreversible operations (send mail, merge, delete) still go through
the consent step (call_consent, your Touch ID or Windows Hello) in either mode.
